This is hymn number 54 titled "Behold, the Mountain of the Lord" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Michael Watson and the lyrics were written by Michael Bruce.
